data.description: This functions as longstrider, except it gives you a +20-foot enhancement bonus to your base speed and a +10-foot enhancement bonus to your other modes of movement (burrow, climb, fly, swim, and so on). It does not affect movement modes you do not actually have-for example, if you do not have a swim speed, this spell does not grant you a swim speed.

raw_tokens.value: As longstrider, plus the speeds of other movement modes increase.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
